channel.title: SSbusinessAndMarket
channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from SSbusinessAndMarket, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: Candace Bushnell on AI, creativity and why originality still wins
item.description: Candace Bushnell, creator of Sex and the City, discusses the importance of authenticity, the value of a creative voice, and building something enduring.

item.title: Talking to a bot might feel good in the moment, but a growing body of research suggests it won’t cure loneliness
item.description: Researchers, psychologists, and bioethicists agree: a good conversation with a bot still isn't the same as being known by another person.

item.title: Conscious unbossing isn’t just a Gen Z thing. I’m a CMO who did it
item.description: Gen Z gets credit for "conscious unbossing." But some people quietly walking away from management are a lot more senior, and AI is a big reason why.

item.title: The $124 trillion Great Wealth Transfer is underway, but nonprofits struggle to engage millennial donors
item.description: Steve Isom of donor-software firm Bloomerang says most nonprofits are mishandling their approach to younger donors.
